statusNote.en: Magnific AI's standalone upscaler was folded into a unified Freepik/Magnific creative platform (single credit-based subscription) as of 2026; magnific.ai now redirects to magnific.com.

keyLimits.en: 240,000 credits/year (~3,200 images), access to image, video and audio generation models plus 250M+ stock assets.
600,000 credits/year (~8,000 images), commercial license, unlimited access to the Nano Banana 2 model.
1.5M credits/year, aimed at professional/agency-level content production.

cautions.en: Displayed prices exclude VAT and local taxes; a 50%-off promotional rate is shown alongside the regular price for annual billing, and regular monthly prices apply without commitment.
Credits are pooled annually across Freepik's image, video and audio tools rather than dedicated solely to the upscaler, so real upscaling capacity per plan varies with other usage.

capabilities.en: AI image upscaling, enhancement and creative reimagining with controls for creativity, resemblance and HDR.
Bundled access to Freepik's broader AI suite: image, video and audio generation models plus a large stock asset library.

limitations.en: No free plan; every tier requires a paid subscription.
Credit-based system shared across multiple AI tools makes heavy upscaling usage consume the same pool as image/video/audio generation.

reason.en: Direct competitor for AI image upscaling and enhancement.
AI creative generation tool overlapping in image enhancement workflows.

missingAlternatives.name: Topaz Gigapixel AI
missingAlternatives.reason: Well-known dedicated AI image upscaler, direct competitor not confirmed in the catalogue's alternativeCandidates for this tool.

unknowns: Exact standalone (non-promotional) monthly-billed price and Business per-seat plan price for Magnific were not fully confirmed on the source page; Business plan figure came only from a secondary search summary, not the primary pricing page content extracted.
